secondary_targets.optimization: Parallelized with OpenMP + single-pass per order instead of per-candidate
Iterate only populated orderkeys instead of full 15M scan

edit_summary: Removed Q18 atomic from lineitem scan (thread-local hashmap), parallelized Q21_finalize with single-pass restructuring, optimized Q18_finalize to skip empty keys.
rationale: Q18 atomic in the 60M-row hot loop adds locked-instruction overhead on every row. Q21_finalize's nested loop re-scans lineitems per candidate. Q18_finalize scans 15M entries when only populated ones matter.
